source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original test has two tab-mode Assert.equal calls and three visibility calls in checkHeaderPopup without a message argument. The helper is invoked for the preview pane, standalone window and message tab, so a failure needs to name the expected control state. The fixed comparison source later supplies a conversation visibility message, but its two mode checks and window/tab visibility checks still omit one. This is a static diagnostic gap, not a claim that an assertion failed. Missing required Bug comment 2 remains separate from the complete own review.
title: The header-action test omits expected-behavior messages at five original assertion sites
